script.problem: Its wrong detail "great kings of old" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.

terra.problem: The verses do not say that those who trust in their wealth are wicked usurpers.
The verses say that the foolish and senseless leave their wealth to others; they do not explicitly say this of wise men. The reference to their graves does not clearly include wise men either.
The verses do not identify those destined for Sheol as the foolish.
